_comment: Placeholders only (RFC 5737 documentation IPs, fake fingerprints). Copy to bigdata.json (git-ignored) and replace every value. Fingerprints: ssh-keyscan <ip> | ssh-keygen -lf - -E sha256. Exactly one node has hdfsHome: true (HDFS is one file system for the cluster). studentOwnsHome false = the manual's 'chown :hadoop' (the owner stays the HDFS superuser, so the student can't write to the home); true = the student owns it.
